name: Chespin
description: Chespin, the Spiny Nut Pokémon. Able to evolve into Quilladin. A Grass type.
pokedex_entries: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.
